svg.aria-label: Mutilated Chessboard Domino Tiling Parity Obstruction and CNF Encoding

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Opposite-corner N×N domino tiling UNSAT formulas (chessboard12, 16, 32) · Bipartite color-parity obstruction (|D| − |L| = 2)
Light corners (0,0) & (7,7) excised → 30 Light, 32 Dark squares remain
eu,v ∈ {0,1} for each grid edge (u,v): n = 2N(N−1) − 4
∀ square u ∈ D∪L: ⋁v~u eu,v (clause len 2–4, positive)
∀ square u, ∀ v≠w ~ u: ¬eu,v ∨ ¬eu,w (84–85% binary Horn)
4 Formats: 3 CNF (16.3 KB) · 3 AIG (18.0 KB) · 3 XCNF (16.7 KB) · 3 ANF (38.8 KB, deg ≤ 3)
